items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I was wondering what key Joe Martinez wrote this thing of mine.

ctx.x: It was just so long ago. Did he play popular music or classical, semi-classical?

He played everything because he was a born musician. He was marvelous. Boy, he took, that's why I saw I was wondering, this was arranged by Confair, I thought, Triangle Jazz Blues. Maybe when we went to Triangle Music Company, maybe Joe Martinez didn't get the job. It's evident that he didn't.
Well, that was done, you see, for the... Just made the... Yeah, that's the whole thing, you know. What I'm trying to say is an orchestration for the band.
